root_idea.summary: Sensing something through attentive perception, especially by hearing.
root_idea.development: The lexical field connects faint or barely perceived sound with attentive listening and with an inward apprehension or thought arising in the mind.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole supplied Quranic form group is displayed under the normalized Form IV perfect citation form.

senses.definition: To feel inward apprehension or fear; to conceive fear in the mind.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic usages, the fear is inwardly sensed or conceived, occurring with constructions such as في نفسه خيفةً and منهم خيفةً.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be frightened by a sound or by another thing that enters the mind or ear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I usage; the stimulus may be a sound or another perceived thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be hidden, imperceptible, barely perceived, or faint and soft.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to something scarcely perceived by the eye, ear, or mind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To conceive or harbor something inwardly in the mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical Form IV use; the Quranic fear construction is treated separately above.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fright or apprehension arising in the heart or ear from a sound or another thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun and noun of the experience of inward fright.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A low, faint, gentle, or soft sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical sense is general; a reported special use concerns a low sound audible to another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To listen for, perceive, or hear a low, faint, gentle, or soft sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject may be an attentive listener or an ear; the action can involve trying to hear a scarcely audible sound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek news or tidings without others knowing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional usage describing discreet inquiry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To taste food or drink repeatedly, taking only a little at a time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes gradual tasting in small successive amounts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A knowledgeable or skillful person, especially one skilled in tracking or circumventing game and attentive to its sounds and movements.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet whose explanation combines general knowledge with specialized attentiveness in game-tracking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An opinion, idea, or object of thought arising in the mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A mental thought or impulse, synonymous with a thought or idea that occurs inwardly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small amount of food or drink; a drop.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported especially in negative expressions, such as saying that one did not taste any food or that no drop remained.
Also reported in the variant الأَوْجُسُ and used in idioms meaning forever or as long as time lasts.
